description: A generic inbound record naming a Subject. WHY only one Event type: this template's authoring-order lesson (docs/PACK_AUTHORING.md SS3) is schemas-first, event-definitions-with-discriminators-second; a pack with several Event types must give each one a required Observation, or a requiredObservationValues constraint, that no other Event definition shares (contracts v1.4, the OIW-110 defect class) — this template has only one Event so there is nothing to disambiguate yet. Add a second Event type only after giving it its own distinguishing required Observation or value constraint.
